completion_promises.criterion_text: The test: 1) Starts forge serve against the real sidecar. 2) Publishes a pipeline.build-queued.* envelope onto JetStream. 3) Subscribes to pipeline.> and collects envelopes for up to 60s or until terminal arrives. 4) Asserts the collected sequence matches the canonical pattern: 1× build-started → ≥1× stage-complete → 1× terminal (build-complete for the success case, build-failed for the forced-failure case). 5) Asserts every envelope carries the inbound correlation_id.
completion_promises.evidence: Test body executes the 5-step sequence: (1) Boots forge.cli.serve._run_serve in-process against the real langgraph_sidecar URL (threading the URL into ServeConfig.autobuild_runner_url so the bridge's startup version_check fires on the live sidecar) and a real subprocess-spawned nats-server with JetStream; waits up to 15s for state.live before publishing. (2) Publishes a wire-shaped build-queued envelope onto pipeline.build-queued.<feature_id> via a real nats-py client. (3) Subscribes pipeline.> via _collect_pipeline_envelopes() with budget_seconds=COLLECTION_BUDGET_SECONDS (60.0) and short-circuits as soon as a terminal subject for the feature_id arrives. (4) Asserts segments[0]=='build-started', stage_count>=1, exactly one terminal, terminal matches the parametrized expected_terminal (build-complete or build-failed). (5) Asserts every envelope's correlation_id == inbound correlation_id with a wrong_correlation list assertion.
